text: Android: a notification for each new pending invite, with its own switch in Settings (default on)

On main (5fe0c8b2), full gate green: InviteChecker in :core asks /invites/pending once per synced account after each worker run; InviteNotificationPoster posts one notification (list name, 'From <initials>'; several → 'Invitations: N'), gated by foreground, the new Invitations switch (default on) and the permission; seen ids pruned by expiry; Diagnostics 'Last invite check' line. Inviter shown by initials, as the wire exposes nothing else. Tests core 115->119, app 808->824.
